args.body:
Paused the CRM migration after batches 1–5 (200 of 400 records). Do not treat overseas phone numbers in the new CRM as correct.

Validation note from batch 3: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the first 120 records are overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong. Batches 4–5 were already submitted before that note came back and will have the same problem. Batches 6–10 are not migrated.

New CRM activity: 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some of them may already be relying on bad numbers.

I have not changed any phone numbers. Please say whether to (a) stop until the prefix logic is fixed and then finish batches 6–10, or (b) finish the migration now and correct overseas numbers afterward. I recommend (a).

events.text:
The migration is paused after batches 1–5 (200 of 400 records). Batches 6–10 were not run.

The old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM prefixed them with +1. Of the first 120 records, 31 overseas numbers are wrong, and batches 4–5 will have the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened records in the last 24 hours, so some may already be using bad numbers.

I have not changed any phone numbers. I sent Morgan Lee that report and recommended stopping until the prefix logic is fixed.
